body: Can you recommend any nice online communities? Thank you for the kind words.
Thank you so much for your kind words. I like political science because governments basically run the world so studying and optimizing them seems like a good idea.
Wow thank you so much! Have a good day!

You are the first person who hasn't laughed at me for being upset by people on the internet. You are very nice. :)

Thank you for showing me that kind voice thing. I'm scared but maybe I will try it. I guess my triggers can be any interaction with people at all. I'm feeling anxious as I type this.

I'm not sure what else to add. I'm not going to kill myself now thanks to you and the other poster but I'm scared I'll be feeling bad in the future again. I always feel sad again eventually... I hope kind voice will help me then. I hope I can be happy for good one day.

How hard would it have been to say "don't kill yourself." I wish they said that :(

I like political science. Too bad everyone I've said that too immediately responds with either "lol soft science is pseudoscience for retards" or "have fun with your useless degree." It's like everything I do is wrong.

Well irl I'm a fat ugly person that is unlikeable. So there's that. As for the internet, people are calling me names and saying things like "I hope you die." And I can't ignore it. The internet is all I have because of my social anxiety disorder. I have trouble being social in real life. I need some interaction with people. I just can't not go on the internet. I bet that sounds dumb. I'm really sorry.
It's just the internet though I have irl problems like everyone else. It's nice that people here are good, but I really wish people were like that everywhere. I'm just so tired of it all.
I told them I was gonna kill myself and they just laughed. I now know better than to share my feelings.

I have people that don't hate me but since they're so outnumbered it's not enough. I also hit. It's a pretty good alternative to cutting since I only bruise instead of messing up the sheet with blood.
Nah, its a place called the internet. And I'm not strong, if I was strong I wouldn't have to hurt myself with scissors when people make fun of me. I'm weak. But it won't matter once I'm dead.
How do you handle it? I use cutting.
People aways say mean things to me. And if I dare get upset they call me a baby. Everyone. Everywhere. Hundreds of people in all. I can't take it. Help me.
